name: A Student of the Arcane
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: While you were away dealing with our vuldren problem, our resident mage trainer--Dorii Brightwhisper--left this recall crystal for you. It contains some sort of message for you, so give it a look. Afterwards, you can find Dorii in the structure just behind me.
narrative.objectives: Examine the Glowing Recall Crystal, then speak with Dorii Brightwhisper in Thendal Grove.
narrative.offerRewardText: Let me have a look at you. Yes, I believe you will make a fine young champion. The power of the arcane has waned amongst our people, but there are those who would seek to rediscover much of what we've lost in the millennia we've spent here amongst the clouds. I am sure that you will lead the charge in this never ending search for arcane knowledge, and ultimately make us proud.Speak with me again if you wish to take your next steps.
narrative.requestItemsText: Greetings, Derek. I'm pleased to have the privilege of furthering your magical studies.
